principle: docs/OPENTALLAS_REDESIGN_PLAN.md gate G3: a provisional budget that is wrong and fails loudly is worth more than a correct one that cannot fail. These budgets are the analytical model's own batch-1 per-user step time for the design point the chip is derived from, widened by a stated tolerance. They are allowed to be wrong. They are not allowed to be absent.

tolerance_note: A measured TPOT within 1.5x of the analytical step passes. The band covers the residuals results/derived/qwen3_n5_design_target_reconciliation.json attributes and does not cover a regime change: a run that is compute-bound where the model is weight-read-bound fails C3 regardless of this band.

measurement_contract.rule: tpot_s is architectural and COMPOSED, not wall-clocked: the per-operator and per-boundary cycle counts are MEASURED in RTL (the same measurements gate G4 calibrates the cycle model against), and they are summed over the issue trace gate G1e certified equal to the golden model's, element for element, on the admitted target timebase. correctness_qualified must be true and composition_certificate must name a passing results/rtl/abi3_g1_composition_certificate.json, so a rate can only be published for a token sequence the whole G1 ladder proved. Host wall time, functional-simulator wall time and roofline figures are refused. Restated 2026-09-05: the previous rule required 'a run whose exact execution identity first passed G1', which the feasibility measurement showed costs 41.7 days per storage class and therefore could never happen -- a budget gate whose measurement cannot exist is the not_evaluable defect wearing a stopwatch. Composition is stronger, not weaker: it requires every operator's cycles to be measured in RTL AND the trace to be certified, where a single run would have required neither to be separable or checkable.

superseded_qwen_rows_2026_09_06.why: The Qwen rows were re-frozen on 2026-09-06 because the design point they named cannot fail on the thesis. At Qwen3-8B/ROM-N5-native-HBMKV-array-tensor-x4 the component times are weight_read 34.465 us, kv_read 67.117, compute 55.703, link 174.275, fixed 6.819, and the overlap rule is max(weight, kv, compute)/0.9 + link + fixed. kv_read dominates the max, so setting weight_read to ZERO leaves the step at 255.668 us to six figures, and ROM would have to become 1.947x SLOWER before the term is visible at all. The frozen budget was 68.2% NVLink all-reduce, 29.2% HBM KV read, 2.7% fixed latency and 0.0% mask ROM: a gate on the ROM thesis that no ROM result of any kind could move. Verified by recomputation, not inferred.

re_freeze_note: Re-frozen 2026-09-06 on the Qwen rows only, and the change makes the gate HARDER, not easier. The headline moves 5.639x -> 5.048x, the unmeasurable inter-die link term drops from 174.3 us (68.2% of the step) to 4.8 us (2.4%), and mask-ROM read time goes from 0.0% of the step to 84.8% -- from an unfalsifiable gate to one a slow ROM array fails. The superseded rows are kept above rather than deleted. The DeepSeek rows are unchanged: a claim that their control-plane cost falsifies them was checked and its attribution found wrong, so nothing there is re-frozen on it.
